grade.name: Nursery
grade.description: Structured writing and reading readiness for ages 3.5-4.5. Covers full alphabet (capital and lowercase), numbers 1-50 with backward counting, Hindi swar and vyanjan, phonics progression, fine motor skills, social-emotional learning with safety topics, and environmental studies through animated videos, tracing, drag-and-drop, and voice activities.
